parsed.answer: Evidence from cryoEM reconstructions of the bacterial 30S initiation complex shows that IF3, together with initiator tRNA, undergoes large conformational changes that facilitate accommodation of fMet-tRNA(fMet) into the P site for start codon recognition. This directly links IF3 activity to the start codon recognition step of bacterial translation initiation. The second excerpt concerns Myc-driven translation initiation and provides no information bearing on this claim.
